data.name: Heading
data.comment: Heading of the card on a plant, cutting or order that lists its attached files. The number of files is shown next to it.

data.name: Add
data.comment: Button and menu item that opens the file picker.

data.name: AddHint
data.value: A receipt, a plant tag or a care card
data.comment: Small text under Add file in the menu of a plant or cutting.

data.name: TypePdf
data.comment: Type shown under a file's name when it is a PDF.

data.name: TypeImage
data.comment: Type shown under a file's name when it is an image.

data.name: RowMeta
data.comment: Second line of a file: type, size and the day it was added, like PDF · 1.2 MB · 3 Nov 2026.

data.name: RowOpen
data.comment: Hidden label of a file's row. {0} is the file's name.

data.name: RowOptions
data.comment: Hidden label of the button with the menu of one file. {0} is the file's name.

data.name: Rename
data.comment: Menu item that renames a file.

data.name: SaveToDevice
data.comment: Menu item that saves a copy of the file on this device.

data.name: RenameLabel
data.comment: Label of the box a file is renamed in.

data.name: RenameEmpty
data.comment: Shown when the name of a file is left empty.

data.name: DeleteAsk
data.value: Delete this file? It goes from every device where you're signed in.
data.comment: Asked before a file is deleted.

data.name: Added_One
data.comment: Shown after one file was added.

data.name: Added_Other
data.comment: Shown after files were added.

data.name: Unsupported_One
data.value: {0} file wasn't an image or a PDF, so it wasn't added
data.comment: Shown when one chosen file can't be kept.

data.name: Unsupported_Other
data.value: {0} files weren't images or PDFs, so they weren't added
data.comment: Shown when chosen files can't be kept.

data.name: TooLarge_One
data.value: {0} file was over 10 MB, so it wasn't added
data.comment: Shown when one chosen file is too big.

data.name: TooLarge_Other
data.value: {0} files were over 10 MB, so they weren't added
data.comment: Shown when chosen files are too big.

data.name: NoRoom_One
data.value: Only 20 files fit on one record, so {0} wasn't added
data.comment: Shown when a plant, cutting or order is full and one file was left out.

data.name: NoRoom_Other
data.value: Only 20 files fit on one record, so {0} weren't added
data.comment: Shown when a plant, cutting or order is full and files were left out.

data.name: AddFailed
data.value: Couldn't add the file. Try again.
data.comment: Shown when adding a file went wrong.

data.name: NotHere
data.value: This file hasn't reached this device yet. It comes when you're online and signed in.
data.comment: Shown when a file was added on another device and can't be fetched now.
